Roadmap and status

A roadmap with acceptance gates—not promises.

Completed, partial, experimental, planned and blocked work is separated so that file count cannot masquerade as readiness.

Current status

The project is early-stage. Status below distinguishes implemented and tested code from experiments, plans and blocked targets.

Implemented · tested

Lexer → VM

The bootstrap compiler, verifier, bytecode artifact and custom VM run the current language subset.

Implemented · CPU

AI engine

Small tensors, autodiff, dense models, training, metrics and serialization are tested on CPU.

Expanded shadow prototype

Semantic self-hosting

Type relations, expression typing, scope/name probes, declarations, assignment, user signatures/calls and returns run in PEACOCK shadow checks.

PEACOCK-authored static export

Website

Twelve actual routes are produced by compiling and running website/site.pac; generated HTML/CSS contains no JavaScript.

Not implemented

Native mobile / GPU / 3D

No Android/iOS build, verified GPU kernel, native 3D renderer or self-hosted VM is available.

Dependency-ordered milestones

A staged migration protects the working compiler and keeps each new subsystem testable.

Next: diagnostics + full modules

Semantic analysis

The shadow kernel is not production-selected; field/method semantics, native overloads, model declarations, complete diagnostics and corpus acceptance remain.

Planned

IR and bytecode

Port AST-to-IR lowering, verification, optimisation and bytecode generation one coherent stage at a time.

Planned

Runtime and packaging

Self-host the VM/runtime and then prove reproducible bootstrap compilation before a self-hosting claim.

Research / partial

Frontend and targets

Build on 2D rendering and this static site export; interactive native UI, 3D, mobile and GPU require independent evidence.

PEACOCK AI

Experimental language and ecosystem. Status is evidence-led, not a release claim.
